input.message:
Dear Ava Fletcher,

Regarding your shower report at Flat 9, 9 Willowmere Road, Bellmere (cold side not running, water sometimes too hot): our provider Meadow Works reported attending and that they cleaned and greased the shower, which they said resolved the issue, and the request was marked complete on 2 June.

We have not had confirmation from you, so before we leave this closed please let us know:
1. Does the cold side of the shower now run normally?
2. Can the temperature be mixed and controlled, i.e. is it no longer too hot to use safely?

If either is still a problem, reply to this message and we will arrange a return visit with the provider. Please take care with the temperature in the meantime.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings
